title: AP Labs module manifest
description: One module: an entry on a hub's menu. Lives at <app>/modules/<id>/manifest.json; its handler, SQL template and test sit in the same folder. Unknown keys are errors.

id.description: Must equal the module's folder name.

hub.description: The id of the hub whose menu lists it.

resource.description: The profile resource key that grants it.

environments.description: Where it shows (APLABS_ENV). Left off the menu, and refused at dispatch, everywhere else.

handler.description: The handler file in the module's folder.

adapter.description: A routing-map module's adapter file in the module's folder (Story 15.4, AD-R16): it exports createAdapter({ data, routing }) giving asOf, input and labels.

screen.description: A routing-map module's screen (Story 15.14, AD-R26): views (the default: Routing's four map views) or route-editor (Plan a route: one crew's day from the Office, reordered by hand; needs routing.depot in the profile and route() in the adapter).

label.description: The form's label for this input; defaults to the name.

pattern.description: A string input's format: a regular expression the whole value must match.

max_length.description: A string input's maximum length, in characters.

query.description: The SQL template file in the module's folder.

row_id.description: The column the query returns that tells rows apart (Win-back: client_id). Required with scoring: ties in score are broken by it.

scoring.description: A deterministic score from 0 to 100 per row, with a reason (Story 10.1, kit/runtime/scoring). The SQL ends with ORDER BY ..., <row_id> LIMIT 5001.

label.description: The input in plain words, used in each row's reason.

weight.description: How much it counts; negative means lower is better.

min.description: The fixed range the value is clipped to and scaled over (min < max).

limit_parameter.description: The declared integer input saying how many rows to keep. The engine keeps the top N after scoring; it is never bound into the SQL.

write.description: An approval-write module's push (Story 10.2, AD-15): one write operation of one connector in <app>/connectors/<connector>/, run only after the person who ran the pull previews and approves it.

operation.description: One of that connector's write operations. It takes { name, contacts, idempotencyKey } (kit/templates/connector.md).

destination.description: Where the list goes, in plain words ("email tool"): the button says "Push to <destination>".

fields.description: The columns the query returns that are copied into the approval entry. Must include row_id.

send.description: What each pushed item holds: the connector's field name, then the field (in fields) it comes from.

list_name.description: The destination list's name. {run_date} is the pull's UTC date; {<input>} is a required input with allowed values (win-back-{zone}-{run_date}).
